name: Inbox Zero
description: Runs through Gmail on working days, clearing out the low-value mail and filing receipts, documents and reference notes where they belong, so unread means something needs a reply. Suited to a single Gmail account and to people comfortable letting a bot archive on their behalf without asking each time.

official.title: Inbox Zero by LD
official.description: Weekday Gmail inbox-zero assistant. Archives noise, files notes, receipts, and docs, and leaves only action mail unread.
